services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery & Landscaping Services in Nottingham
services_subhead: From routine crown maintenance to emergency storm clearance and full garden redesigns, we deliver safe, professional arboricultural work.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe removal of dead, diseased, or unwanted trees. We handle large specimens in confined spaces and manage all debris. Fully insured and certified for complex felling work.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Thin, reduce, or reshape mature trees without damaging health. Perfect for improving light, reducing wind resistance, or tidying overgrown specimens.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage Clearance
services.desc: Rapid response to fallen trees and branches blocking access. We clear hazards safely and restore your garden—call us 24/7 for urgent work.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular or one-off hedge cutting keeps boundaries neat and healthy. We handle everything from small garden screens to large perimeter hedges.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Grind out stubborn tree stumps below ground level so you can reclaim the space. Ideal before new planting or landscaping projects.

services.title: Garden Landscaping & Redesign
services.desc: Transform overgrown spaces with professional design and planting. We combine tree work with hard landscaping to create gardens you'll love.

about_pullquote: I got into tree surgery because I care about the trees. We never cut corners.
about_para_1: Wayne Grant has spent over 18 years in arboriculture, building a reputation for meticulous, safe tree work across Nottinghamshire. Starting as a ground-up arborist, Wayne invested in professional certification, specialist equipment, and public liability insurance to deliver work that meets—and exceeds—industry standards. Today, his reputation rests on taking time to understand each tree and each client's needs.
about_para_2: Homeowners and property managers return to Wayne because he listens. He won't recommend felling if pruning will do, and he always leaves gardens tidy and clear. A straightforward quote, honest advice, and work done right the first time have made him the go-to arborist across Nottingham and the surrounding villages. References are gladly supplied.

reviews.text: We had a massive oak that was blocking light from the back of the house. Wayne came out, explained exactly what he'd do, and removed it without a speck of damage to the fence or garden. Brilliant job and very fair price. Can't recommend him enough.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Storm brought down a large beech across our drive. Wayne was here within two days and cleared everything safely. Professional, efficient, and tidy. Exactly what you want when you're in a panic.
reviews.author: Sarah H.

reviews.text: Called for a hedge trim and ended up getting proper advice on reshaping the whole boundary. Wayne did the work himself, not some subcontractor, and the garden looks transformed. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David L.
